comments.author: Speenks
comments.body_html:
The ‘move for x distance’ conditions were actually a recurring issue when I was working with Light to get QE updated. It seemed every other build would fix one thing and then break the movement conditions. We tracked it down to a mismatch between QE looking for the “main” player’s movement and Fika not having a “main” player. With versions 3.3.0 and higher, it “works”, but for some reason, is inconsistent. For example, it works 99% of the time on my dev profile, but on my actual playthrough with my partner, we could only get it to track like 5% of the time.

I’m still doing my actual playthrough to test the experience of the mod outside of a dev environment before releasing a minor/balancing update, but in the meantime you have 3 options:

  1. You could keep playing and maybe get that lucky 5% trigger (not recommended, and sorry you are experiencing this)

  2. If you are savvy, you can add the parentId: 687043be1536e1df14033147

to the first two conditions: 687043be1536e1df14033143 and 687043be1536e1df14033144

in the BlackMarket_Weasel.json to mark the condition as optional.

  1. You can use Skipper to bypass the condition. Make sure you get the version for 3.11.
